name: twostroke_twin
label: 350 cc two-stroke parallel twin
notes: Invented reed-valve street twin with a 180-degree crank and one expansion chamber per cylinder. Bore and stroke (64 x 54 mm) are the Yamaha RD350's published figures (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Yamaha_RD350), used only as a starting size: that engine's port timings were not found, so this is not a model of it. Compression ratio, rod length, port timings, port areas, crankcase ratio, intake and pipe dimensions, redline, idle and flywheel are typical values chosen by Claude, not taken from any engine.
